title: AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic.play_stream bus argument is ignored.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.dev4
- Reproducible in 4.6.2
- Reproducible in 4.3

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev4 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6650 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21043.5001) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12600KF (16 threads) - 31.82 GiB memory

### Issue description

The "bus" argument in AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic.play_stream is ignored, and sounds are played on the AudioStreamPlayer's default bus instead. Sounds should instead play on the passed bus.

### Steps to reproduce

For the MRP: Run the example project. It will play a click sound even though play_stream is being called with the "Music" bus, which is set to mute.

The code used is:
```
extends AudioStreamPlayer


func _ready() -> void:
	play()

	var playback: AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic = get_stream_playback()
	playback.play_stream(load("res://click1.ogg"), 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, AudioServer.PlaybackType.PLAYBACK_TYPE_DEFAULT, &"Music")
```
Where the Music bus has been set to mute and the AudioStreamPlayer has been assigned an AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[audio-bug-replica.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26661956/audio-bug-replica.zip)
